drafts.title: The Farcical Apocalyptic Kitchen
drafts.reasoning: This scene focuses on the escalating tension between Ursula and Hitler within the bunker setting, using their distinct personalities to create humor while building towards a big reveal.
drafts.scene: A dimly lit underground bunker with flickering red lights. Bombs explode in the distance, adding an ominous background noise. Miles and Owen are tied to counters. A hobo is seen outside through a window, yelling 'Yee-haw!' at the strange events unfolding inside.

dialogue.line: Alright, you Nazi freak! I'm the executive producer now, got it?
Quiet, woman! You will address me as Fuhrer!
Execu-wha?! What's that supposed to mean, anyway?
It means nothing! Just do as ordered or face the consequences.
Why must everything be so chaotic, Kyle? Can't you control this... this... thing?
Satisfyingly vague. That's all a dictator needs.
What’s going on out there? Why are they laughing at us?
This is not funny, Charlie. You understand that, right?
Foolish man! You will cease this nonsense immediately!
